folds.body:
The root review notes, R2–R9 review corrections, pre-R4/pre-R5 checkpoints and R12 pre-R13 transfer were read in full. Keep their exact negative evidence with the earlier rounds: R4 useful paid routines and eight restoration comparisons did not measure exact native stamina debit/refund; a transported Save is not a genuine Export. R5 guided comparison established preparation rather than procedure reading. R7 focused checks were included in affected checks. R8 final normal reload equality across seven groups differs from Export adding cached weapon rarity, with the getter cause only inferred; it supplies no final literal-import or whole-character-export equality. R9 explicitly preserves the R8 over-budget FAIL_CLOSED and the missing exact timeout operation. No historical cost is erased through reacquisition or replay.

R12 established public SOURCE applicability only: its identified exposure consumer was in paused World1 and public structured definitions had zero containers. Twenty-two contract checks do not make that native path played or complete. Keep R8 fail-closed, R10 lost snapshot/no reconstruction and R11 error stop separate, as in the later final checkpoint. The early documents identify model selection only where visibly checked; High 3of3 alone does not establish the model. Historical next-round launches, transfers, specialist permissions, preview ports and account ceilings grant no current execution or writer reservation. Under AD32/AD36/AD42, reviewer prose establishes neither product authority nor current behavior, and optional human review does not invalidate the bounded agent evidence. No original save, browser, private capture or runtime source was reverified here.
